sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 17 and Internal Quality Checks row 17: 'The reference plausibly implements every feature/screen the instruction asks for.')
evidence: Walked instruction.md and all three notes (environment/instructions/conversations.md, integration.md, walls-and-retention.md) line by line against solution/app (hashes of server.js 03b52651..., app.js 8fc558c9..., index.html 6a49714f..., styles.css a1f47f96..., transcript.css 66737ce9..., seed f69616e2..., solve.sh f7c17a01... recomputed and equal to raw-evidence-index matching_source_files). Every asked-for screen/role/flow has an implementation: SIGN-IN gate: index.html:10-21 sign-in card, app.js:60-70 boot shows it unless /api/me ok; all /api routes call requireUser (server.js:182-186), transcript returns 'Not available. Please sign in.' (server.js:493). ROLES/WALLS: canSee server.js:189-193 (clients own matters, staff unless walled); applied in matter list (250), thread/detail (331-338), search (381), mentions (321-323), link previews (226-235, per reader), reply quotes (same-matter parent, 287), unread (counts only visible matters), versions/message routes (198-201, 354-369), transcript (495-496); direct access gives 404 'Not available.' (21, 335). Partner adds/lifts walls: server.js:470-481 + UI wall-form index.html:66-73, app.js:247-278,484-490; live removal via 2s polling -> showUnavailable (app.js:558-569, 197-210). TIMER: off/1/7/30 (server.js:20,458-468), label beside title (246, index.html:49-50), partner-only, shortening sweeps at once, sweep uses >= age (138-146), never restores. DELETION: eraseMessage clears body, versions, mentions (150-154); placeholder only if live replies (253-279); reply quote shows deleted (287, app.js:305-306). HOLD: partner-only place/release on any message (448-456), timer skips held (142), author delete refused when held (443), release re-sweeps (454), 'On hold' badge thread (app.js:309) and transcript (server.js:506). THREADS: any-depth replies, children ordered by seq under parent (253-279), short quote (287, app.js:303-308). EDITS: author-only PATCH with version check -> 409 and composer text kept (server.js:418-435; app.js:401-414 returns before resetComposer), 'edited' label, staff-only versions (361-369, app.js:341,454-471); author delete (437-446). FORMATTING: escape-first formatter with *bold*, `code`, '> ' quote, http(s) links target=_blank (app.js:22-54); quotes/search/versions use textContent/escapeHtml; transcript esc() (server.js:485). LINKS: Copy link box (app.js:443-452, index.html:103-107), /messages/:id previews or 'Linked message not available' (app.js:311-327). MENTIONS: first-name or full-name, only people who can see the matter (server.js:209-222), Mentions view + count (index.html:31,92-95; app.js:511-521). UNREAD: server-side per user/matter (reads table, 239-245), deleted excluded, new-messages line (app.js:186-187,284-289), open marks read (189), Mark unread from any message (434-442, server.js:344-347). SENDING: client_key idempotency (server.js:396,403-407; app.js:7,389,409), seq ordering everywhere. LIVE: 2s polling keeps composer, scroll and open versions (app.js:224-238,558-569). PHONE: @media max-width 720px single-column layout (styles.css:114-123), overflow-wrap:anywhere on messages. SEARCH: case-insensitive current text, no deleted/versions, click opens thread at message (server.js:375-384, app.js:501-509,528-553). TRANSCRIPT: matter number, title, generated time, threaded oldest-first, author/time/edited/hold, versions for held+edited, placeholder, no controls (server.js:488-509). REFUSALS: inline persistent errors next to the action (composer-error, per-message action-error, timer-error, wall-error, signin-error). RUNTIME: __dirname-relative paths, 0.0.0.0:3000, DB_PATH, health 200 even when init throws (42, 156-165), WAL SQLite with all state incl. reads/sessions, one-time seed guarded by settings.seeded (93-128), fixed clock from seed (2026-05-12T11:00:00Z, verified), seed copy in /app/seed identical to /assets, no app.db or symlinks shipped. Runtime corroboration: qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/golden-run.log (sha256 4da6ab5d..., matches index) records PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional checks (signin_and_client_scope ... persistence, incl. real kill/restart) and polish_refusal_in_place on these exact source hashes; this is a scripted golden run, not a configured judge/Oracle run, and it does not cover the 390px phone layout or render/visual rows, which I verified by CSS reading only. Adversarial: I looked for a brief item with no implementation (e.g. hold mark in search snippets, edit-time display, wall-error clearing) and found none that the public text actually demands; minor latitude (stale versions store edit time CLOCK for prior body, not displayed) is not a missing deliverable. A broken alternative reference (e.g. client-side wall filtering) is not what ships here; walls are server-enforced on every route listed above.
